description: This PHP trait provides helper methods for managing entities within an ORM context, including repository access, persistence, removal, query building, pagination, fetching, references, and transaction management.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the repository for the specified entity class, configured to either be an ObjectRepository or EntityRepository based on the entity class.

parameters.name: entityClass
parameters.description: The fully qualified name of the entity class.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists the given entity and flushes changes to the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the given entity and flushes changes to the database.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a Doctrine QueryBuilder for the specified entity class with an alias, optionally with an index by clause.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Wraps the provided QueryBuilder into a Paginator object for paginated access to query results.

methods.name: getQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Wraps the provided QueryBuilder into a QueryBuilderWrapper object for additional functionality.

methods.name: fetchOne
methods.description: Executes the query with a specified offset and returns a single result object or null if no result is found.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Gets a reference to an entity by its class name and ID, without fully loading it.

methods.name: rollBackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current database transaction.
